title: Belgrade taxi drivers announce protest against proposed regulations

tea.why: Taxi drivers object to proposed changes to the city's taxi transport decision, alleging they favor large companies and bypass regulations.
tea.want: The withdrawal of disputed amendments, review of taxi licenses issued to legal entities, and verification of legal compliance.
tea.changed: Nov 20: The Association of Belgrade Taxi Entrepreneurs announced a protest for November 23 outside the city assembly.

summary: Taxi drivers in Belgrade have announced a protest for November 23, 2026, outside the city assembly building, organized by the Association of Belgrade Taxi Entrepreneurs (SITAB). Protesters oppose proposed amendments to the city taxi transport decision, claiming the changes legalize breaches of existing limits on vehicles registered to companies and favor large corporate operators. According to SITAB, the number of corporate vehicles has exceeded the maximum limit, and the amendments would normalize regulatory non-compliance. Their demands include the immediate withdrawal of the disputed amendments from the city assembly's agenda, a review of permits issued to legal entities over the past five years, and a check on legal conditions for these firms. No official response from city authorities was reported in the sources.
demands: Immediate withdrawal of the disputed amendments to the taxi transport decision from the city assembly agenda
Review of all taxi and vehicle permits issued to legal entities in the past five years
Verification of legal compliance for companies operating taxi services
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: SITAB announced a protest for November 23 outside the Belgrade City Assembly against proposed changes to taxi regulations.
